source_note: 部分积的上界估计与Gautschi不等式
english_source_note: Upper Bounds for Partial Products and Gautschi's Inequality
callout_id: 部分积的上界估计与Gautschi不等式#4
statement_en:
Let $H_N$ denote the $N$th harmonic number. Then for every positive integer $N$,
$$H_N>\log(N)+\frac{1}{2}.$$
callout_body:
$H_N$表示第$N$个调和数，那么对任意正整数$N$都有
$$H_N>\log(N)+\frac{1}{2}$$
